title: Auto Candy Farm
features: Pulls all the candy toward you like a magnet
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local hrp = player.Character and player.Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart") or player.CharacterAdded:Wait():WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local baseSpeed = 5
local maxSpeed = 1000
local offset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(delta)
    local candies = workspace:FindFirstChild("CandyPickups")
    if not candies then return end

    for _, v in ipairs(candies:GetChildren()) do
        local part = (v:IsA("Model") and (v.PrimaryPart or v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))) or v
        if part then
            local targetPos = hrp.Position + offset
            local direction = targetPos - part.Position
            local dist = direction.Magnitude
            if dist > 0.1 then
                local speed = math.clamp(dist * 3, baseSpeed, maxSpeed)
                local move = direction.Unit * math.min(speed * delta, dist)
                part.CFrame = CFrame.new(part.Position + move)
            end
        end
    end
end)
